description: Tailor the member’s existing resume to one active listing and save the copy. Requires a paid plan; uses no application credits. Call only when the member requests it. The copy is written in the background: while status is generating, call again with the same listing_id in about a minute to read it. A repeat call returns the same copy and never pays for a second one. Limited to 10 calls per minute. Returns a Studio link and a quality score delta against the same source and listing, not a predicted hiring outcome. Never invent candidate facts.
name: tailor_resume
title: Tailor your resume
